datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact BZT52C20S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 8d99c0b95ddbd62581320fd03378a72d97d914bc201c735536cd50e5f6753113.

The BZT52C20S row gives VZ minimum 18.8 V, nominal 20 V, and maximum 21.2 V at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 55 ohm at IZT; maximum ZZK = 225 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 14 V; and admissible IZM = 5 mA, all at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate readings from the real curve labelled 20 in p. 3 Fig. 2 at plotted logarithmic-current grid values of 0.5, 1, 2, 5, and 10 mA; the plotted current axis was converted from mA to A and no intermediate points were synthesized. Reverse-bias polarity is cathode positive relative to anode.

The p. 3 typical capacitance graph is a shared series-level plot with bias curves versus nominal zener voltage and no tabulated BZT52C20S capacitance value, so capacitance is omitted rather than assigned a component-specific value.

No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null. The p. 1 maximum ratings also specify PD = 200 mW and VF = 0.9 V maximum at IF = 10 mA.
